messages.text: I booked for 4pm and NOBODY came!!! Second time this happens. Totally unprofessional.

Hi Sara, I'm really sorry. You were expecting us at 4pm and we didn't arrive or let you know — that's not good enough. Our technician was delayed at an earlier job. We can be with you **today at 6pm** or **tomorrow at 10am**. Which suits you better?

demo.note: Sample business and customer. The owner checks every draft before sending.

problem.title: Your business runs on WhatsApp. So does your evening.
problem.body: Every message deserves a fast, friendly, correct answer. But the same questions arrive while you're with a customer, on site, or finally at home. Then there's the quotation to write from scribbled notes, the overdue invoice, the review that needs a careful reply, the Instagram post nobody planned, and the lead who read your price and went quiet.

before.title: Why “just using ChatGPT” gives generic answers
before.body: A general AI chat doesn't know your prices, your opening hours, your cancellation policy or how you talk to customers. So it guesses, or sounds like a brochure. You end up rewriting everything.

after.title: What changes with this kit
after.body: You describe your business **once** — services and prices, hours, areas, booking, payments, policies, tone, languages and your top FAQs. Every assistant uses that profile. When something is missing, it asks you or writes **[CHECK]** instead of making it up.

demosTitle: Real jobs in. Ready drafts out.

demos.label: Notes → quotation
demos.input: mirdif villa, paint 3 bed + hall, walls only, our paint, 1800 per bed, hall 2200, 4 days, half advance
output: Bedroom walls, painting incl. paint — 3 × AED 1,800 = **AED 5,400**
Hall walls, painting incl. paint — 1 × AED 2,200 = **AED 2,200**
VAT line: only if you're VAT-registered — marked [CHECK] for you to confirm
Timeline: 4 working days · Payment: half in advance, balance on completion
demos.flag: Plus a short cover message for WhatsApp
demos.note: Sample figures from a fictional business.

demos.label: 1★ review → reply
demos.input: ★☆☆☆☆ “Waited 40 minutes past my appointment. Nobody apologised.”
demos.output: Thank you for telling us, and we're sorry your visit started this way. Waiting past your appointment time isn't the experience we want for anyone. We'd like to understand what happened and make it right — please message us on [CONTACT] so we can speak with you directly.
demos.flag: No arguing in public. No admission of legal fault.
demos.note: Sample review for a fictional business.

demos.label: “How much?” → answer
demos.input: Hi, how much for deep cleaning a 2-bedroom in JLT? Can you come Saturday?
demos.output: Hi! Deep cleaning for a 2-bedroom apartment is from AED 450 (sample price), depending on the condition. Is it furnished or empty? Saturday — [CHECK: availability]. If you share your location, I'll confirm a time for you.
demos.flag: Never guesses availability — marks it for you to check
demos.note: Sample price from a fictional business.

inside.title: Ten assistants. One profile. Your voice.
inside.intro: Each assistant comes with copy-paste instructions, 2-minute setup steps for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, three “try it now” examples and tips to improve results.

items.name: WhatsApp Enquiry Replier

items.name: Quotation & Proposal Writer
items.desc: Turns rough notes into a clean quote or proposal, with a VAT line placeholder for you to confirm.

items.name: Payment Reminder Assistant
items.desc: Friendly, then firmer, then final. Never threatening.

items.name: Google Review Responder

stepsTitle: Up and running in about 10 minutes

steps.title: Describe your business
steps.body: Fill in the essentials of your Business Profile: services and prices, hours, booking, payments and your top FAQs.

steps.title: Set up an assistant
steps.body: Copy its instructions, paste your profile in, and save it in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini — or paste into a new chat on a free plan.

steps.title: Paste, check, send
steps.body: Paste a customer message or your rough notes. Read the draft, fix anything marked [CHECK], and send it yourself.

guardrailsIntro: The kit is written so you stay in charge of every word your business sends.
guardrails: Uses **your** prices, policies and facts — and writes **[CHECK]** instead of guessing
Flags **OWNER DECISION NEEDED** for refunds, discounts and complaints with legal risk
No legal, tax, medical or investment advice
Reminds you never to paste Emirates ID, passport, card or bank details
Adds “have a fluent speaker check” to every Arabic, Hindi or Urdu draft
Keeps hiring fair: no criteria based on nationality, gender, age or religion
statsTitle: Written for the businesses that run the UAE.

stats.text: The UAE ranked first in the world for AI adoption in Q2 2026, with 73.3% of working-age people using generative AI.
SMEs are about 95% of companies operating in the UAE — owner-run businesses where the owner is also the front desk, the sales team and the accounts department.

fit.title: Is it for you?

offer.title: One download. Everything ready to use.

refund.title: 7-day no-questions refund
refund.body: Download the kit, fill in your profile and try the assistants on your real messages. If it's not right for your business, ask for a refund within 7 days. No questions asked.

faq.q: Do I need to be technical?
faq.a: No. You copy, paste and type. The start guide takes you from download to your first draft in about 10 minutes.

faq.q: Do I need a paid AI plan?
faq.a: No. It works on free plans by pasting the instructions into a new chat. Paid plans let you save each assistant so it's always ready.

faq.q: Which AI app should I use?
faq.a: Any of ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Setup steps for each are in every assistant file.
You set your tone, greetings and sign-off once, and you can save your best replies so the assistants copy your style. You edit every draft.

faq.q: What if it gets something wrong?
faq.a: The assistants are told to use your facts and write [CHECK] when unsure. The privacy and safety guide includes a quick check before you send anything.
Yes. Arabic drafts come with the English meaning and a reminder to have a fluent speaker check.

faq.q: Is it safe to paste customer messages?
faq.a: Remove phone numbers and personal details first, and never paste ID, card or bank details. The guide shows you how.
The quotation writer adds a VAT line placeholder if you're VAT-registered, for you and your accountant to confirm. It doesn't give tax advice.
Yes. Share the assistant instructions with your team, and use the SOP writer to create training material in their language.

faq.q: What if it isn't right for me?
faq.a: Ask for a refund within 7 days. No questions asked.
